gumroad_listing.description:
204,535 active licensed electricians and electrical contractors in Texas — sourced directly from the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) public database.

**License classes included:**
- Master Electricians
- Journeyman Electricians
- Apprentice Electricians
- Electrical Contractors
- Residential Wiremen
- Maintenance Electricians
- Sign Electricians

**Fields per record:**
- License holder name
- License type / class
- License number
- Business address
- City
- ZIP code
- Phone number
- License expiration date
- TDLR source URL (every row)

**Who buys this:**
- Electrical supply distributors (Graybar, Anixter, Rexel) targeting Texas contractors
- ServiceTitan / Jobber / Procore SDRs targeting electrical contractors
- OSHA & safety training providers
- Electrical CE (continuing education) companies
- Liability insurance brokers writing contractor policies
- Electrical equipment manufacturers and reps

**Data source:** Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) via Texas Open Data Portal (data.texas.gov) — mandatory public disclosure under Texas Government Code §552. No auth bypass. Business address and phone only — no personal home address, no SSN.

One CSV file. 204,535 rows. Instant download.
